_preset: python-library — an installable Python package (no long-running service). project_type: library runs the always-on rules (build/test/quality/reproducibility, community/context/security) with the service pack off. Add "advanced" to packs if you publish an SBOM or want code-scanning.
_bootstrap_command: BUILD-05 crown check on a clean checkout. Adjust for poetry/uv/hatch (e.g. 'uv sync && uv run pytest').
_packs: add "advanced" to enable SBOM, static code-scanning, mutation testing, dependency-vuln-scan, coverage-floor. ('profiles' is the legacy alias; --profile advanced the CLI form.)
